title: Split remaining MCP server responsibilities into focused private modules
description: Split remaining MCP server responsibilities into focused private modules
acceptance_criteria: MCP server implementation and unit tests are organized into cohesive private responsibility modules; the orchestration file and each new source or test file target fewer than 1000 lines unless a documented cohesive boundary requires more; public API and CLI and MCP JSON and diagnostics and ordering and limits and filesystem authority remain unchanged; all 124 MCP unit tests and 72 integration tests remain represented and pass; canonical spec coverage stays complete and no existing test or trust gate is weakened
